fields.description: A day of the week. A closed Select rather than a Link, because the seven days are not a society's vocabulary to extend and a register of them would be a table nobody should have to seed. This is the one closed list in the availability model; everything else about when somebody can serve is the society's own answer.

fields.description: The window on that day this volunteer is free, from the society's own VMMS Availability Slot register. The slot carries the hours; this row carries which day they apply on. Together one row means "Saturday afternoons", and a schedule is a handful of them.
fields.label: Availability Slot
